Rune reasoning: Zilean — Chronoshift revive health: AP or adaptive stats enter the native heal/shield helper. Gathering Storm is fixed at minute 30; Absolute Focus is selected only above 70% owner HP. Revitalize is tested on the actual recipient rather than assuming low owner HP means low ally HP. Ability basis: R3 revival restores1100+2AP; huge AP coefficient rewards Deathcap/raw AP/Staff. Test heal-power/Revitalize eligibility instead of assuming revive ordinary healing. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee increase AP ratio. Staff suppliesAP plus pretriggered40AP Rapids; Redemp Summon Aery: Aery damage/shield is a separate packet; do not fold it into native ability capacity or damage. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Conditioning: Minute-12 armor/MR; direct only for matching resistance scaling, otherwise survival utility. Revitalize: Native eligible heal/shield modifier; low-HP bonus follows the actual recipient, not automatically the caster.

Rune preparation: Recipient is ally. Revitalize bonus below 40% is conditional on that recipient at application; do not silently grant it at full HP. Aery/Guardian/Font heals or shields remain separate from the named ability. Axiom Arcanist is an eligibility candidate for this ultimate heal/shield; verify true source tagging, including Mantra, revive and pet/passive exceptions. Do not infer eligibility from slot R alone. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Revival is its own event class: test Axiom and Revitalize independently on the actual revived HP, with identical target maximum HP. Do not assume ordinary heal modifiers apply to resurrection solely because the tooltip says restoring health.

Rune comparison: Compare a real 12-stack Conqueror page with Revitalize at the same recipient state, and AP versus HP shards if missing-health caps limit effective recovery. Extra combat preparation must be logged separately.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

builds.name: Time Bomb: legal two-bomb sequence
builds.summary: Investigate high two Time Bomb explosions from one Q-W-Q sequence output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high two Time Bomb explosions from one Q-W-Q sequence output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each Q deals 75/115/165/230/300 + 0.9 AP magic. A second bomb on the same bombed unit detonates the first immediately and stuns; the second still has its own three-second timer. Two legal rank-5 explosions nominally total 600 + 1.8 AP, not three damage events from placement and detonation.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After [3] seconds it detonates, dealing [75 / 115 / 165 / 230 / 300 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.
